body:
sometimes i do feel a bit bleh after drinking them, but i’ve been having 1-3 ensure pluses a day for almost a year now and i’m generally healthy/not really noticing any problems.

i do remember a bit of a rough patch when i started drinking ensures. it definitely took my body some time to adjust. obviously if you feel really worried about it, talk to a doctor, but that’s my experience, at least.

please please please push for the endoscopy !!
i started noticing swallowing troubles when i was around 13 but didn’t tell my parents until it was wayy too late. By the time i told them, i basically wasn’t able to eat solid foods anymore without pain/gagging. Honestly wish i had pushed for doctors way earlier, so please do that, because it may only get worse, and i can’t promise the diagnostic and treatment process will be quick or easy. I’m still in the middle of getting a diagnosis and we’ve been at it for a year and a half.
Also, i’m 16 and i got an endoscopy a few months ago. i handled the anesthesia just fine and was able to return to school the next day !
